Equipment

What to run it on.

Your agent runs on a computer of yours, so the first question everybody asks is which computer. Usually the answer is the one you already own. Answer a few questions and Ember lays out the kit for your setup, including the parts you can skip.

Your kit Question 1
If you would rather just be told

The short answer.

The picker above tailors this. Here it is untailored, which is right for most people.

Use the computer you already have, if you do not mind leaving it on, awake and connected: your agent can only answer while Archie is running. If you are buying, buy a small desktop. A Mac mini is the one we would buy ourselves; a small Windows desktop does the same job, and what matters is that you can leave it on, not that it is fast. The rest is an AI account and a plan, neither of which is hardware: the whole list sits with the setup steps.

Save your money

What you don’t need.

A page recommending equipment has an obvious incentive to make the list longer. Here is the list of things people expect to need and don’t.

Not needed

  • A graphics card. The thinking happens on your AI company’s computers, not yours. Archie sends the request and waits
  • A fast or new computer. It spends most of its life idle, waiting for something to happen
  • A server, a NAS, or anything in a rack. Archie is a desktop app with a window
  • A second monitor, or any monitor after setup. You need a screen to set it up. After that you can talk to it from your phone or a chat app
  • A separate internet connection, or a static address. Nothing connects to your computer: it reaches out, and nothing on the network can reach in

Worth having

  • An Ethernet cable, if the machine can sit near the router
  • Disk space, if you want it to talk out loud or work with audio and video: those tools run on your computer and download to it
  • A power strip with battery backup, if your power flickers. It is the difference between a blip and a machine that stays off until you come home
  • A phone, which you have. It is how you reach the agent when you are not at the computer

We don’t print hardware prices here, because we would be quoting somebody else’s price back at you and it would be wrong within the month. Every machine named on this page is one you can price yourself in a minute, at the maker’s own store.

Still not sure it is the right machine?

Tell us what you have and we will tell you whether it will do, including when the answer is that it won’t. It is a question, not a sales call.
